purpose: Teach: プログラマー/ユーティリティ/短大/本学/南側/伝送/陳列/懲戒

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、プログラマーを早期に採用された
lines.en: Your father hired programmers early on, you know.
lines.style: Quiet, measured reflection. Slight pause before the sentence, like he's drawing up a memory. Gentle certainty — not questioning, honoring.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはユーティリティ家具に投資された
lines.en: Yes. He invested in utility furniture too.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Not elaborate — a simple agreement that carries the weight of understanding what these choices meant. Level, consistent tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、短大卒社員にも幹部の道を用意された
lines.en: He made sure junior college graduates had a path to management.
lines.style: Soft voice carrying quiet pride. Slight emphasis on the memory itself, not on the telling. A pause underneath, like he's thinking: this mattered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは本学への寄付も続けられた
lines.en: He did. And he kept supporting the university too.
lines.style: Calm, steady delivery. Each detail placed carefully, like laying stones. Not rushed. The tone of someone honoring a pattern he understands deeply.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本社の南側に庭を作られた
lines.en: He had a garden put in on the south side of headquarters.
lines.style: Quieter now, almost dreaming the detail aloud. Small smile in the voice. The particular tenderness of remembering something small that revealed something large.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは早期にデータ伝送網を整備された
lines.en: Yes. He set up the data transmission network early, didn't he.
lines.style: Quiet statement, not quite a question. Reflective pause underneath. A man placing another piece of a pattern he's lived with, understood over decades.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、商品陳列にこだわった
lines.en: He cared deeply about how products were displayed.
lines.style: Soft, almost intimate tone. The voice of someone remembering not just a fact but a quality of attention. Slight trailing affection at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の懲戒よりも教育を選ばれた
lines.en: He chose education over discipline for his staff. That was his way.
lines.style: Gentle finality. Slow, settled delivery. The tone of a man who has lived long enough to understand why his father chose what he chose. A quiet statement of something profound, simply said.
